description: Water hydrants is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. This data set includes all in service water (fire) hydrants on the Dedicated Fire Protection, Distribution, and Transmission water subsystems. Some hydrants maybe out of commission and this is indicated on the data set. Data currency The extract on this website is updated weekly. Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Water and sewer. Its keywords are water. The portal shows 6,613 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
